title: India's Asian Games Badminton Campaign Falls Short of Expectations
indian_angle: This report reviews India's performance at the Asian Games 2026 badminton events, highlighting the men's team bronze and individual disappointments.
summary: India secured a men's team bronze at the Asian Games 2026 badminton, but individual events saw disappointment, including Satwik-Chirag's unexpected early exit.

title: Para-Badminton Star Pramod Bhagat Flag Bearer for Para Asian Games
indian_angle: Indian para-badminton star Pramod Bhagat was named the flag bearer for the Indian contingent at the upcoming Para Asian Games.
summary: India's Para Asian Games contingent received a warm send-off, with para-badminton star Pramod Bhagat honored as the flag bearer.

title: Prakash Padukone Urges Greater Consistency from Indian Shuttlers
indian_angle: Legendary Indian shuttler Prakash Padukone has called for improved consistency from current Indian badminton players.
summary: Badminton legend Prakash Padukone expressed his desire for Indian shuttlers to achieve greater consistency in their performances on the international stage.

title: National Coaching Camp for World Junior Championships Kicks Off in Guwahati
indian_angle: A national coaching camp is underway at NCE Guwahati to prepare Indian junior players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting a coaching camp for Indian players selected for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India conducted a Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course across two national centers to enhance coaching standards.
summary: BAI organized an advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, for aspiring coaches.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented in Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The 3x15 scoring system has been adopted for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
